text: Regional Director

As a proud graduate of the Milpitas Unified School District, I am honored to run for the Milpitas School Board. I attended Spangler Elementary School, Thomas Russell Middle School, and graduated from Milpitas High School. My experiences helped shape the person and leader I am today. I'm committed to giving back to the community that invested in me by helping ensure every student has the opportunity to succeed.

I hold a Master's degree in Education and have spent more than 15 years serving adults with intellectual and developmental disabilities. Throughout my career, I have focused on creating opportunities, building strong community partnerships, and helping individuals reach their full potential.

I have also had the privilege of serving as Chair of the Silicon Valley Chamber of Commerce, where I collaborated with business and community leaders to strengthen our region. Through my service with the Milpitas Knights football and cheer programs, I have supported local youth by promoting teamwork, leadership, and community involvement.

I will bring thoughtful leadership, fiscal responsibility, transparency, and a collaborative approach to every decision. My commitment is to listen, put students first, support our educators, and ensure Milpitas schools continue to provide every student with the opportunity to learn, grow, and thrive. I would be honored to earn your trust and your vote.

text: Executive Director/Business Professional

I have been on the Milpitas Unified School District Governing Board for 12 years. I am currently serving in my 5th term as Governing Board President. I am a 40+ year resident and proud product of Milpitas schools. I am experienced, dedicated, and a proven community leader. I am a listener and Builder of the Culture of We which has led to the successful completion of the MUSD Innovation Campus and Milpitas Performing Arts Center

Community accomplishments: President Santa Clara County School Boards Association. California School Board Association Member of the Year. California School Boards Association Artificial Intelligence (Al) Policy Task Force. Chair City of Milpitas Economic Development & Trades Commission. Milpitas Kiwanis Club. Community Hero Award. Milpitas High School Hall of Fame.

Professional accomplishments: Founder Bay Area Tutoring Association. Silicon Valley Tech Executive. Chief Strategist SV Education Foundation. Stanford University Information Technology Systems Analyst.

Married 26+ years. Parent of 2. Bachelor of Science Degree, Christian Leadership. My top priorities for Milpitas Unified School District are Al career readiness, school district safety, continued fiscal responsibility, extra curricular activities (theatre, music, sports), and retaining a professional educator workforce. Endorsed and supported by local, county, state and federal elected officials. Vote to reelect Chris Norwood https://electchrisnorwood.com

text: Engineer/City Commissioner

I am Anuradha Sankaran, a Milpitas resident, an engineer with 20 years of technology experience, City Commissioner, education volunteer, and parent of a 2026 MUSD graduate, seeking to serve on the MUSD Governing Board.
Throughout my career, I have led projects, managed resources, and developed practical solutions. I will bring accountability and sound decision-making to MUSD governance.

My service includes two years on Rancho Middle School's Community Board Advisory Council, part of the School Site Council; two years as Fundraising Chair for the Milpitas High School PTSA; and three years organizing educational and cultural programs at a nonprofit community language school. As an Environmental and Sustainability Commissioner, I support the Commission's environmental awareness efforts.

My priority is ensuring every student has opportunities to pursue college and career pathways and succeed in a technology-driven world, while closing achievement gaps and strengthening readiness for admission to competitive colleges. Drawing on my STEM experience, I will promote partnerships with colleges and technology companies to expand hands-on learning, internships, digital skills, and responsible artificial intelligence education. I will champion safe, inclusive schools, student mental health, qualified teachers, and responsible budgeting that protects educational quality. I respectfully ask for your vote.

text: Governing Board Member/Educator

As Vice-President of the Milpitas Unified School District Board, I am honored to serve our students, families, and community. A proud Milpitas resident for nearly 20 years, I have provided unwavering leadership as Board President, three-term Vice-President, and two-term Board Clerk. My civic commitment extends across Milpitas as past president of both the Milpitas Chamber of Commerce and Milpitas Rotary Club.

I deeply value public education, and our vital work is far from finished. As a mother of two current Milpitas High School students and an MHS graduate now at UC Santa Cruz, my dedication is personal. As a credentialed educator who has taught in our local classrooms and served on the PTA, School Site Council, and Community Board Advisory Council, I bring firsthand insight into classroom needs. I earned my Bachelor's Degree in Law & Society from UC Santa Barbara.

As a local real estate and mortgage business owner, I apply sharp financial management and entrepreneurial problem-solving to protect taxpayer dollars and maximize resources for our schools. My top priorities are advancing student achievement, expanding teacher recruitment and retention, enhancing campus safety, and delivering transparent fiscal oversight.
I respectfully ask for your vote to keep moving MUSD forward. www.kellyformilpitas.com
